1.title: Trump’s Super PAC Is Tied to Mystery Group Spending $25 Million on Midterms
1.summary: The recently created Republican group is pumping cash into half a dozen key midterm races, with the largest amounts going toward Senate contests in New Hampshire and Alaska.

2.title: Trump Is Orchestrating the Republican Midterm Convention Like One of His Rallies
2.summary: The Republican Party is holding a midterm convention in Dallas this week. But as our White House correspondent, Maggie Haberman explains, despite President Trump’s unpopularity in polls, this event is shaping up to be a rally focusing on his achievements.

3.title: US to ban imports of some Canadian alcohol, dairy goods and motorbikes
3.summary: It is the latest strike in a long trade war, and comes after Canadian counter-tariffs on US goods come into force.

5.title: Oil hits $100 a barrel for first time since July after US and Houthi strikes
5.summary: Brent crude - the global benchmark for prices - rises after the US hit five Iranian tankers on Tuesday

6.title: Europe Unites to Pressure Israel, Breaking With U.S.
6.summary: Britain once followed in France’s slipstream when it came to pressuring Israel. Under new leadership, it is spearheading opposition to Israeli settlements, risking American anger.
